title: Miso cod with greens
summary: Miso cod with greens is a japanese dinner built around cod fillets and pak choi, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat cod fillets dry and season it. Prep pak choi and rice miso paste for Miso cod with greens so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook cod fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook pak choi and rice miso paste in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Miso cod with greens before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice cod fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
